paragraphs: DEVNET sells property tax and land records software to local government, under an Edge product line covering mass appraisal, assessment administration, billing, collection, permitting, records management and mapping. Its applications are meant to give a comprehensive view of the entire property tax life cycle from appraisal to collection.

The suite also reaches personal property, mobile homes, special assessments, tax calculation, distribution and delinquent tax processing. EdgeMaps provides real-time GIS integration, with configurable web maps powered by the Esri ArcGIS platform living inside DEVNET software. A public portal lets residents and outside agencies reach property and appraisal data and pay tax bills online. The maintenance agreement includes future releases, upgrades, bug fixes, training, support, travel and legislative changes at no additional cost.

DEVNET is privately held and was founded in 1997 to supply integrated software and hardware to local government. It serves over 120 jurisdictions across Illinois, Iowa, Michigan, Missouri, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Dakota, Virginia and Wisconsin. The company says its solution values and collects revenues for over 4.5 million parcels each year. Staff include former county government officials alongside developers. DEVNET is a member of the International Association of Assessing Officers.

quote.text: DEVNET integrates the entire tax cycle while also providing the public, outside agencies, and partners the information they need.
